mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods following the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods following the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% month-over-month and Real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and GDPC1 increases > 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).
